albums.name: #80: Rewritten
albums.description:
It’s a time of endings and beginnings in Odyssey. Buck Meltsner is drawn back into shadows he thought he’d left behind when a face from his past forces him to confront truths he can’t escape. 

Meanwhile at Whit’s End, Renee Carter uncovers an old Imagination Station program that could finally shed light on her deepest questions—but could cost her more than she ever expected. And when a sudden fire shakes the town, Whit’s words land in the spotlight, challenging the people in Odyssey to consider what’s truly important.

It’s a season of soul-searching for characters at the crossroads in this milestone chapter of Adventures in Odyssey. As the past returns in surprising ways, endings become beginnings and the future is… Rewritten.

Don't miss these unforgettable stories from Album 80—the final Odyssey collection to be available on CD, download and radio. That's right, beginning in January 2026 all new episodes will live exclusively in the Adventures in Odyssey Club. Stay tuned for more information!

albums.description:
When Odyssey High’s resident mean girl, Valerie Swanson, offers Jules Kendall a chance to get even with a musical rival, Jules reluctantly agrees. She knows Valerie is trouble—but she’s desperate enough to take the risk. As Jules resorts to bigger and bolder lies to cover her tracks, she begins to wonder if her ambition has finally gone too far. But is it too late to turn back?
 
Meanwhile, Mr. Whittaker sends Morrie and Suzu on a secret mission—one designed to teach valuable lessons. But the siblings have secrets of their own. And over at Whit’s End, Renee Carter wrestles with one of life’s oldest and hardest questions: Why would a good God allow terrible things to happen?
 
The clock ticks toward midnight as the folks in Odyssey face monumental decisions.

This new creation would improve the lives of thousands, even millions of people. But without proper guidance, it could fall into the wrong hands. Eugene, Katrina and Buck must face the most difficult decision of their lives with consequences that will ripple through their friends, family, and maybe even the whole world.

As past, present and future collide at a critical turning point, the folks in Odyssey realize that even in difficult times, the best is yet to come.

Renee and Horus have a scientific breakthrough of monumental proportions. But there’s a catch: the technology is based on Mr. Whittaker’s Imagination Station and he didn’t give them permission to use it! Will Renee risk her friendship with Whit in the name of science? Meanwhile, Olivia gives her testimony at church and big questions are raised that she can’t answer. Can she take the next step in her faith journey while still reflecting God’s love? Elsewhere in town, friendships are at stake when Buck and Jules hit a rough patch that could endanger theirs. Morrie and Suzu try to find a healthy path toward making new friends. And Wooton faces a courtroom struggle that may pit him against an old friend.

It’s a time of next steps - both forward and backward - as the folks in Odyssey face all sorts of twists and turns. Keep your hands and arms inside the car at all times and buckle up. Look for a new episode every Thursday through January 19!

episodes.name: Judge Me Tender

episodes.name: As Buck Would Have It, Part 1 of 3
episodes.shortName: #931: As Buck Would Have It, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: Buck Oliver receives an anonymous message that leads him back to his hometown of Harlanville - and the forgotten story of his father’s death.

episodes.name: As Buck Would Have It, Part 2 of 3

episodes.description: Buck and Jules learn more of Buck’s family history from a long-lost friend while Eugene and Katrina consider Buck’s future in their family.

episodes.name: As Buck Would Have It, Part 3 of 3

episodes.description: Buck’s place in Odyssey and with the Meltsners is put to the test through unlikely friends and foes.

episodes.description: Hear actor Robby Bruce, voice of Buck, talk about how he got started on Odyssey - and hear his original audition.

albums.name: #71: A Slippery Slope
albums.description: I’m sure you don’t want everyone to know what you’ve really been up to... Who is blackmailing Cooper Calhoun? Odyssey’s junior detective Emily Jones is forced to work with unlikely teammates Morrie and Suzu Rydell once more. Then, Zoe and Olivia are thrilled when an anonymous donor pays for the class ski trip. But Pastor Wilson wonders if the visit to the mountain might fulfill the mysterious message he received: One of three will fall. And when a young girl faces struggles with her faith and asks big questions, her friends and family try to reconnect and draw her back to God. Journey through some tough problems with the Odyssey crew in Album 71: A Slippery Slope.

episodes.description: When Emily Jones discovers that Cooper Calhoun is being blackmailed by a faceless hacker, she reluctantly recruits two people who she knows could help – Morrie and Suzu Rydell.

episodes.name: Please Adjust Your Frequency
episodes.description: Buddy Norman, Zoe Grant, and Jay Smouse create a radio play for a school project, but each of them has a wildly different idea about how the story should end.

episodes.name: Higher Than Our Ways
episodes.description: Olivia Parker and Zoe Grant are excited when money mysteriously shows up for a class ski trip, but Jason Whittaker and Wilson Knox worry that the trip could be connected to a premonition of danger.

episodes.name: Triple-Decker Sundae
episodes.description: Olivia finds that putting together her personal testimony for church is more challenging than she realized. Friends give advice that is both helpful and harmful.

episodes.name: Set a Watchman
episodes.description: Zoe hopes that a winter retreat at Camp What-a-Nut will be a good time to reconnect with Olivia, but plans for a time of fellowship and renewal are continually thwarted.

episodes.name: Worth It

episodes.name: Search for a Sunflower
episodes.description: Will it lead to fame or misfortune when someone steals Penny's flower paintings before her big art show?

episodes.name: Hurricane Perkins
episodes.description: The Perkins clan upsets another military family by sharing too much about life’s challenges ... and rat milk.

episodes.name: The Revenge of Bigfoot
episodes.description: During a spooky troop campout at Trickle Lake, Jay and Buddy run into a snorting, snarling man-beast.

episodes.name: Voice of Freedom, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: A young soldier’s loyalties are tested when his government – and his father – hunt down and arrest Christians.

episodes.name: Voice of Freedom, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: In a hostile land, Ji-ho risks everything to learn more about God's Word and protect the underground church.

episodes.name: The Snow Must Go On
episodes.description: As a winter storm rages, the Calhoun family needs to work together to get Joseph to the hospital in time.

episodes.name: Sew On and Snow Forth
episodes.description: Whit and Wilson get caught in the crossfire when a ladies’ sewing club starts bickering over a group project.

episodes.name: Snow 'Em Who's Boss
episodes.description: Who will take charge when Wooton and his young passengers skid off the road on their way to a leadership retreat?

episodes.name: Make Snow Mistake
episodes.description: While the search for Wyatt continues, Buck and Jules are stranded alone at school as our blizzard saga concludes.

albums.name: #70: Finding a Way
albums.description: Mysteries lurk around every corner in Odyssey and the citizens in Odyssey must find a way through the confusion to arrive at the truth. After Wyatt winds up in the hospital after a crazy stunt, Mr. Whittaker searches for the answers about what really happened. When Connie’s car is stolen, Detective Polehaus’s investigation leads him on a surprising path from one familiar face to another. And when Emily Jones is falsely accused of a crime and winds up in detention, she must decide if she will solve a case with two others who could be guilty as well: Morrie and Suzu Rydell. As the truth comes to light in each situation, the folks in Odyssey learn timely lessons about confronting fear, true heroism, and new beginnings.

episodes.name: Jumping Off, Jumping In
episodes.description: Wyatt starts taking silly risks, like eating hot chips, leaping from sheds, and venturing into the lair of a ravenous beast. Is Jay putting him up to it ... or is it tied to something that happened to his sister?

episodes.name: Auto Response
episodes.description: When Connie's car is stolen, Detective Polehaus tracks down what really happened and the surprising link to other Odyssey residents.

episodes.name: Unrelatable
episodes.description: After a caller says that her on-radio advice is unrealistic, Connie puts Wooton's scheduled show on hold to convince her audience that she can, in fact, relate to her listeners.

episodes.name: The Protector
episodes.description: Wyatt attempts to use his newfound protective instinct "superpower," while Carla worries that she's losing connection to her daughter, Bridget.

episodes.name: The Christmas Bells
episodes.description: Jason and Wilson tell Zoe the story of Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, the author of a famous Christmas carol. It's a story filled with joy, tragedy, and ultimately truth about God's role in difficult circumstances.

episodes.name: Let's Call the Whole Thing Off
episodes.shortName: #909: Let's Call the Whole Thing Off
episodes.description: Emily Jones is pulled into another case when she gets in trouble for having a cell phone in class that she insists is not her own. Upon reaching detention, she finds that Morrie and Suzu Rydell have also been falsely accused.

albums.name: #69: Best Kept Secrets
albums.description: Long-held secrets are uncovered and major revelations are about to be revealed in Adventures in Odyssey Album 69: Best Kept Secrets. Listeners have long wondered whether Morrie Rydell is behind the strange events happening in Odyssey. The truth will be brought to light in these episodes. Elsewhere, Jules’s mother suddenly arrives in to Odyssey to take Jules back to California, maybe for good. What will happen to Jules, her newfound musical career, and her friends back in Odyssey?

episodes.name: The Rydell Revelations, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: Emily Jones begins her exhaustive investigation into the mastermind behind a number of mysterious occurrences in Odyssey, including the student council election, the opened lockers, the escape room, and more.

episodes.name: The Rydell Revelations, Part 2 of 3
episodes.description: Whit reveals additional clues to Morrie’s misdeeds around town of Odyssey - the untold story that motivated them.

episodes.name: The Rydell Revelations, Part 3 of 3
episodes.description: Secrets about the past and present are finally revealed as Whit, Emily, and Morrie get to the bottom of all the puzzling happenings in the town Odyssey.

episodes.name: For a Song
episodes.description: After seeing the popularity of Valerie’s homespun music, Jules decides to start writing her own songs about what’s going on at her school. Soon a musical battle heats up between the two girls, catching friends in the crossfire.

episodes.name: California Dreams, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Jules’s mother suddenly arrives in Odyssey to take Jules back to California. Despite protests from Connie and Buck, Jules decides to leave town … maybe for good.

episodes.name: California Dreams, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Jules’s rollercoaster of a musical career hits a seeming high-point, but her friends and family back in Odyssey must deal with the ramifications of her new-found fame.

albums.description: All of the episodes in Club season 7.

episodes.description: It's all hands on deck when a series of clues appears to connect Whit's End with a survivor of the Titanic.

episodes.name: Unsinkable, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: As the luxury liner takes on water, what will become of Nina, her father, Henry and the other passengers?

episodes.name: Out of Her Element
episodes.description: Desperate to improve her chemistry grade, Renee agrees to let Horus help her prepare for the final exam.

episodes.name: Young Whit and the Revolutionary Secret

episodes.description: What will Johnny do when he tangles with a bully and learns the shocking truth about a 10-year-old war hero?

episodes.name: Bridget, Redefined
episodes.description: When Odyssey rallies behind her military family, Bridget Perkins declares war on sympathy and special favors.

episodes.name: Cars, Trains, and Motorcycles
episodes.description: Friendships get tested during a wild, wacky road trip to Chicago to visit Penny’s art exhibit. Detours ahead!

episodes.name: Millstones
episodes.description: Renee learns that ethical choices take practice, while Connie's campaign to help a friend creates moral dilemmas.

episodes.name: Badges of Honor
episodes.description: Lagging behind other girls in their troop, Olivia and Zoe set out to earn as many merit badges as they can.

episodes.name: A Simple Reminder
episodes.description: Left in charge of her father's farm, a naive girl faces temptation when a wily salesman comes calling.

episodes.name: The Martyr and the Rooster
episodes.description: A man arrested for his faith makes it his mission to keep the peace and share Christ in a Burmese prison.

episodes.name: The Forever Gift
episodes.description: Penny can't wait to revisit her hometown, then is shocked to discover how much things have changed.

episodes.name: Teach a Man
episodes.description: Local teens learn how to film inspirational stories when Jay follows Zoe on a mission trip to Honduras.

albums.name: #68: Out of the Blue
albums.description: Jaws drop and eyes are opened at the surprises happening around the town of Odyssey. Everyone is finding or learning something unexpected! When Connie’s roommate Jillian sets out to find a job, the hunt takes her all over town. But whether it’s destroying a window display at Triple J Antiques, causing chaos at Odyssey General Hospital, or trying her hand at meteorology, she just can’t catch a break. Will she ever find the perfect fit for her unique skills? Meanwhile, Penny and Wooton have a wonderful surprise to share when her parents come for a visit - if they can ever find the right time to tell them. And Wyatt resorts to using extraordinary methods when he uses a lie detector to show his sister Bridget how much he misses hanging out with her. But the biggest surprises won't be revealed until you listen to these six adventures. Don’t miss a single twist, turn, or bombshell in Odyssey!

episodes.name: Good Job!
episodes.description: Connie Kendall makes it her mission to get Jillian Marshall the perfect job in town. The journey takes them from Triple J Antiques, to Whit's End, to the hospital, and even to Odyssey Channel 10. Meanwhile, Trey Calhoun struggles to overcome his failures in school and step out of his older brother's shadow.

episodes.name: Playing Favorites
episodes.description: Upon hearing that all parents have favorites, Olivia and Matthew Parker decide to find out their father's preferred child using a lie detector. Next door, Wyatt Perkins resorts to drastic measures to spend quality time with his sister Bridget.

episodes.name: A Wise Surprise
episodes.description: With Penny's parents coming for a visit, the Bassetts plan an elaborate scheme to announce a special surprise for them. But when Frank and Eleanor get the wrong impression of what's coming, Wooton and Penny must figure out the right way to give them the real news.

episodes.name: Breaking News
episodes.description: Station manager Sky Feldstein tells TV news anchor Ted Humphries that he needs to be more relevant. Ted turns to Zoe Grant for youthful advice. To update his image, he reports from the local trampoline park and inside a video game.

episodes.name: BONUS! Behind the scenes of "Breaking News"
episodes.shortName: #883a: BONUS! Behind the scenes of "Breaking News"

episodes.name: Always Home
episodes.description: Ron Perkins has been stationed overseas with the Marines for a long time, and Bridget and Wyatt are missing their dad. Whit creates a special Imagination Station adventure to help them with their feelings ... but it has a surprising twist.

episodes.name: Further from the Truth
episodes.description: Emily finds a strange note in her locker that launches her on a mystery. The more she investigates, the more she sees that the path of clues is connected to her best friend Matthew Parker!

albums.name: #67: More than Meets the Eye
albums.description: When Emily and Matthew find themselves trapped inside an unfinished escape room in the basement of Whit’s End, their only way out is to follow the clues to unlock the steel door before time runs out. Meanwhile, new wide receiver Buck Oliver faces some unexpected challenges on the way to the high school football state championship when the team hires a new assistant coach – Eugene Meltsner. Across town, Connie Kendall’s wedding planning business becomes more complicated than she ever imagined when a family member raises suspicions about the groom’s past. Don’t miss a single twist or turn in these six adventure-filled stories.

episodes.name: Rightly Dividing
episodes.description: Pastor Knox becomes concerned about Camilla’s fiery prayer for her soccer team’s victory and Declan consults Lou for advice on dealing with a bully at school.

episodes.name: BONUS! The true story behind "Rightly Dividing"
episodes.shortName: #874a: BONUS! The true story behind "Rightly Dividing"

episodes.name: Man of the House
episodes.description: Wyatt takes it upon himself to start fixing things around the house – including a washing machine. Meanwhile, David decides that it’s time to take Matthew on a camping trip to teach him to be a man.

episodes.name: Page from the Playbook
episodes.description: As the Odyssey High School Football team heads toward the state championship, wide receiver Buck Oliver and quarterback Cooper Calhoun have to deal with unexpected challenges from Jay Smouse – who’s trying to sell team memorabilia – and their new assistant coach… Eugene Meltsner.

episodes.name: A Sacrificial Escape
episodes.description: Emily and Matthew are trapped inside an unfinished escape room in the basement of Whit’s End. A mysterious voice insists that the two of them must play a game called “Search for Your Life” to get out.

episodes.name: Nightmares by Constance, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Two days before a “Dreams by Constance” wedding, the grandmother of the bride approaches Connie with a proposal: she’ll pay her double if she breaks up the ceremony.

episodes.name: Nightmares by Constance, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Connie, Jason, Jillian, and Detective Polehaus continue their investigation of the suspicious groom and discover that his – and the whole family’s – past is more complicated than they could have imagined.

albums.name: #66 ½: Club Season 6
albums.description: All of episodes in Club Season 6.

episodes.name: In a Sun-Scorched Land, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #862: In a Sun-Scorched Land, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Matthew learns about a young boy forced to flee his home after rebel soldiers raided his African village.

episodes.name: In a Sun-Scorched Land, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #863: In a Sun-Scorched Land, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: The children's faith and courage are tested as they struggle to survive and reach the refugee camp.

episodes.name: Between Camp and a Hard Place, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #864: Between Camp and a Hard Place, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Summer camp has everyone excited. But can Olivia and others adjust when things don't go as planned?

episodes.name: Between Camp and a Hard Place, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #865: Between Camp and a Hard Place, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Kids and counselors face numerous challenges as the competition heats up at Camp What-A-Nut.

episodes.name: Rumpelstiltskin: A Wee Little Tale
episodes.description: A fresh spin on the classic tale of a greedy king, a desperate girl, and an elf who turns straw into gold - for a price.

episodes.name: Take Every Thought Captive
episodes.description: Mean girl Valerie Swanson visits a strange city that's oddly familiar, yet unlike anything she's ever experienced.

episodes.name: All for the Guest
episodes.description: It's a stressful sleepover when Penny's parents and Wooton's childhood butler come to visit on the same weekend.

episodes.name: B-TV: Idolatry
episodes.description: A collector of artifacts learns valuable lessons about idols, including that they aren't always what they appear to be.

episodes.name: The World of Whitonia
episodes.description: There's trouble in paradise when a pushy professor slithers into Renee's latest Imagination Station program.

episodes.name: Icky and Kat and Balty and Bones
episodes.shortName: #871: Icky and Kat and Balty and Bones
episodes.description: Learn about the folly of superstitions in this fun, musical retelling of The Legend of Sleepy Hollow.

episodes.name: The Morning Star
episodes.description: During a visit to London in 1413, Matthew Parker is shocked to discover that most people can't read the Bible.

episodes.name: Lifted Out of Context
episodes.description: After Buddy's fears get the best of him, a young daredevil gives him a pep talk from the Bible ... sort of.

albums.name: #66: Trial by Fire
albums.description: After years of searching for his true identity, Buck Oliver may finally get some answers. But along with clues about his family, he also is subjected to the dangers of his past. Buck’s old mentor Mr. Skint arrives in town with an offer that would take Buck away from Odyssey for good. Elsewhere, Connie feels unappreciated when Jules starts looking up to new roommate Jillian more than her own sister. And the crew at B-TV chart a course deep into the ocean to learn more about the concept of the Trinity. Dramatic conclusions and fresh beginnings abound in these six entertaining and inspiring adventures in Odyssey!

episodes.name: Much Ado about Jealousy
episodes.description: When Jules starts turning to her new roommate Jillian for advice, Connie worries that her close relationship with her sister is being snatched away.

episodes.name: Same Mold Story
episodes.description: Mold forces the Parker family out of their house. Until it’s fixed, Matthew stays with Grandma Lucia while Olivia and Camilla stay with the Bassett family. What seems like a dream come true for the kids eventually turns into a mission to save their family.

episodes.name: B-TV: Trinity
episodes.description: The Trinity. What is it? How does it work? And why is it important? In the latest edition of B-TV, Connie, Harlow Doyle, Captain Quidd, and Jacqueline Cusco dive (quite literally) into this important topic.

episodes.name: The Long End, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: A mysterious package arrives at the Meltsner home containing clues about Buck’s checkered family past while a hope chest at Jason’s antique shop may be the target of an old nemesis.

episodes.name: The Long End, Part 2 of 3
episodes.description: As Buck and the Meltsners continue to unravel the questions surrounding Buck’s backstory, his old mentor returns with the promise of answers – for a price.

episodes.name: The Long End, Part 3 of 3
episodes.description: The conclusion of Buck and Mr. Skint’s sordid tangle of cons finally leads Buck to learn the truth about his family, both past and present.

albums.name: #65: Expect the Unexpected
albums.description: There’s never a dull moment in the town of Odyssey! From a mysterious police investigation to an internship at a funeral home, every situation leads to unexpected results. When Zoe Grant and Olivia Parker start a new talk show, they reluctantly choose Jay Smouse as their first guest. But his talent of stuffing his mouth with jelly beans leads to frantic and frightening consequences. An impromptu Parker family picnic turns into an unusual opportunity for David as he decides to go to extreme lengths to prove a point to his kids about initiative. And Buck and the Meltsners face a sudden dilemma when a social worker questions Eugene and Katrina’s role as Buck’s guardians. Don’t miss out on a single shock, twist, or turn as the folks in Odyssey learn about fame, friendship, family, and more in these six exciting stories.

episodes.name: The Shame About Fame
episodes.description: Olivia Parker and Zoe Grant start a new talk show and reluctantly choose Jay as their first guest. However, when Jay starts choking live on their show, the girls become famous for for reasons they didn’t expect. Meanwhile, Connie and Jules have conflicting opinions on their next potential roommate: Jillian Marshall.

episodes.name: The Sandwich Initiative
episodes.description: When the Parker children forget to bring some food inside from a family picnic, David makes it his mission to teach them about initiative. The methods he uses to get the message to his kids become more and more extreme.

episodes.name: BONUS! Behind the scenes of "The Sandwich Initiative"
episodes.shortName: #851a: BONUS! Behind the scenes of "The Sandwich Initiative"

episodes.name: The Toy
episodes.description: Detective Polehaus investigates an unusual case involving a young boy and a small toy. The trail of clues leads him to Lily Graham, Jason Whittaker, Wooton Bassett and more. Meanwhile, Connie is surprised by the work habits of a new volunteer at Whit’s End.

episodes.name: The Good in People
episodes.description: When Olivia Parker makes a bold promise to the drama Club about going to a festival, Morrie Rydell decides to secretly test just how far she is willing to go to keep her word.

episodes.name: Not What I Expected
episodes.description: When the kids in Odyssey are assigned internships around town, Zoe ends up at a funeral home (with Jay Smouse!) and Emily works at a law firm. Both find their experiences to be far different than they expected. Meanwhile, Jillian looks for ways to sell her jewelry in Odyssey.

episodes.name: Divided We Fall
episodes.description: When a social worker witnesses Buck falling from a treehouse, the future of Eugene and Katrina as foster parents is put into question.

albums.name: #64 ½: Club Season 5
albums.description: Not a big fan of cliffhangers? Then you’ll be glad to know that, after a year dominated by multi-part adventures, Season 5 will feature 12 self-contained stories. Episodes will reveal more about Whit’s family, a certain cosmic copper, and ministries such as Prison Fellowship and Trail Life USA. Stay tuned for plenty of fun and surprises in 2018!

episodes.name: Rewinding the Big Picture
episodes.description: Frustrated in her attempts to cheer up a friend, Camilla gets a series of do-overs in the Room of Consequence.

episodes.name: Met His Match
episodes.description: Convinced that Whit is lonely, Penny and Olivia play Cupid in hopes of introducing him to the next Mrs. Whittaker.

episodes.name: Failing to the Finish Line
episodes.description: The Square One Club's passion for inventing shifts into high gear when Matthew builds an impressive go-kart engine.

episodes.name: Drake and the Time That Time Forgot
episodes.shortName: #841: Drake and the Time That Time Forgot
episodes.description: Space-age officers Drake and Woots encounter a time-traveling scientist on a questionable quest to change history.

episodes.name: Mean Streak
episodes.description: A mean girl from Connie's past wants to reconnect. Meanwhile, Jules hatches a plan to teach her own bully a lesson.

episodes.name: Always Do Your Best-ish
episodes.description: Olivia and Renee run into unexpected obstacles while working on a school play and a new Imagination Station program.

episodes.name: Charlotte
episodes.description: A friendly game of chess ends abruptly when painful memories put Whit and Wilson's friendship to the test.

episodes.name: Walk Worthy
episodes.description: Buddy and Jay explore what it means to live with integrity as members of a wilderness troop for boys.

episodes.name: The Last Straw
episodes.description: Forgiveness is in short supply when Olivia proves unreliable and Connie insults someone on her radio show.

episodes.name: Beyond Repair
episodes.description: With Pastor Knox along for support, a nervous young woman finally visits the prisoner who betrayed her.

episodes.name: The New Olivia
episodes.description: Ready for a new image, Olivia Parker discovers how an extreme makeover can take on a life of its own.

episodes.name: Out to Sea
episodes.description: During a visit to the Florida Keys, an ocean getaway lands Whit, Eugene and Wooton in a boatload of trouble.

albums.name: #64: Under the Surface
albums.description: A scuba-diving adventure leads to an unlikely investigation as Wooton and Penny try to find the owner of a camera they discovered at the bottom of Trickle Lake. And that’s not the only long-hidden secret being uncovered in Odyssey! When Whit sends Olivia and Matthew on an Imagination Station adventure to Old Testament days, the pair discovers that their heroes have unpleasant dark sides too. The Jones & Parker Detective Agency investigates an author’s long-lost final manuscript and discovers that the mystery may be bigger than they ever imagined. And after Buck laments his lack of family connections, Eugene takes him on a road trip to find more about the boy’s bewildering personal history. In these six thrilling adventures, you’ll discover the reason millions of people can’t wait to hear another exciting adventure in Odyssey!

episodes.name: Your Honest Opinion, Please
episodes.description: After Wooton accidentally gives a negative review of Penny’s artwork, he feels that he must do everything to keep from offending her. This includes allowing her to hang her frightening clown paintings all over the house. Meanwhile, Connie shares a studio with a fellow student who is insensitive of his own annoying habits.

episodes.name: The Secret of the Writer's Ruse
episodes.shortName: #833: The Secret of the Writer's Ruse
episodes.description: After a long dry spell, the Jones and Parker Detective Agency is back with what could be their biggest case yet: an investigation into a manuscript that could be famous writer Mary Malloway’s long-lost final mystery.

episodes.name: Sir Buddy's Snowy Day
episodes.description: When school is cancelled, Buddy goes sledding with the Parker family. On the way to the park and back, he faces a series of menacing obstacles and fights with a new nemesis while trying to retrieve a coat for the maiden Olivia.

episodes.name: David and Absalom, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: When Matthew and Olivia debate the merits of their heroes, Whit sends them on an Imagination Station adventure to meet two from the Bible: King David and his son Absalom. Matthew is excited to meet David, and Olivia is soon taken by young Absalom. But the siblings quickly discover that their heroes are far from perfect.

episodes.name: David and Absalom, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: When Matthew and Olivia debate the merits of their heroes, Whit sends them on an Imagination Station adventure to meet two from the Bible: King David and his son Absalom. Matthew is excited to meet David, and Olivia is soon taken by young Absalom. But the siblings quickly discover that their heroes are far from perfect.

episodes.name: BONUS! Behind the scenes of "David and Absalom"
episodes.shortName: #836a: BONUS! Behind the scenes of "David and Absalom"

episodes.name: Out of the Picture
episodes.description: Wooton and Penny find a digital camera at the bottom of Trickle Lake and determine to find its owner. However, the camera’s owner may have a strange connection to Wooton himself. Meanwhile, Buck laments his lack of family connections so Eugene takes him on a road trip to find more about his history.

albums.name: #63: Up in the Air
albums.description: Wooton Bassett returns from his honeymoon with two major problems - Penny is missing and his memory is gone! The journey to find his new bride means probing the depths of Wooton's crazy mind while also reliving his honeymoon - everything from skydiving in Nicaragua to singing on stage with Wooton's favorite band, the Pool Boys! Meanwhile, Eugene and Connie deal with the highs and lows of raising teenagers. Connie's half-sister Jules tries to recreate her life in Los Angeles by making a new friend - school troublemaker Valerie Swanson. albums.description: Everyone in Odyssey is putting on a show. Jules Kendall feels like she’s in the spotlight and has to live up to everyone's expectations. albums.name: #60: Head Over Heels
albums.description: In the world of Odyssey, life's issues rarely come together without a hitch. For Penny and Wooton, the answer to a marriage proposal leads to even more questions. Will Wooton meet with Penny’s family’s approval? And will Penny believe the best about Wooton even after the evidence seems to pile up against him? Meanwhile, others in town are asking questions of their own: The Parker family wonders if Mom will ever learn how to ride a bike, Whit unexpectedly questions whether his daughter should move to town, and Emily wonders how an unknown hero is thwarting the robberies across town. Throw caution to the wind and find the answers as the folks in Odyssey jump head over heels into the path of truth and discernment.

albums.name: #58: The Ties That Bind
albums.description: Who knew that a comic-book convention, a poster, and a pastoral visit could cause so much drama in Odyssey? Wooton’s got his hands full with a notorious blogger after announcing the creation of a new comic book idea—and he has to deal with a wayward cousin. Whit refuses to join in a local festival and finds himself in a citywide tug-of-war between conviction and compromise. And the unexpected return of various relatives and former adversaries triggers complications for Connie, Eugene, and the rest of the Odyssey gang. It’s the perfect blend of excitement, comedy, and important life-lessons in this special 14-episode collection!

A trip in the Imagination Station is usually fun, but three generations from the Parker family are surprised to find that it can be life-changing, too. And who doesn’t love the circus, especially when it involves solving a mystery behind sabotage and betrayal? And Connie's life is turned upside-down by an unexpected phone call, triggering major changes for everyone around her. In laughter or tears, you can count on the gang at Whit's End to make life's surprises fun, exciting, touching, and rich with lessons from God.

albums.name: #55: The Deep End
albums.description: Jason Whittaker discovers a life-threatening plot in the works after he tracks the villainous Mr. Grote to London. Back in Odyssey, rumors fly when a wedding brochure is mistaken for an announcement and everyone thinks Connie is getting married. Eugene and Katrina hear unsettling news about their future. And Kids’ Radio tells the exciting story about how a backcountry man with a simple desire for peace winds up on the front lines of World War One.  Amidst all of the conflict and comedy, our pals in Odyssey learn that being in over their heads can be a a very touching and funny experience when God is put in the center of it all.

albums.name: #54: Clanging Cymbals… and the Meaning of God's Love
albums.description: What is the true meaning of love? The kids in Odyssey will find out even while the town is buzzing with competition. A scavenger hunt pits Matthew, Jay, and Barrett against each other in a musical extravaganza. Can Barrett take his eyes off the prize to focus on what’s truly important? Meanwhile, Olivia struggles to show “brotherly love” when Matthew wants to take away her role as Wooton’s camp assistant and Eugene must decide how to be honest when Connie showers him with a string of gifts...that he can’t stand. Integrity, trust, and forgiveness are all put to the test as the folks in Odyssey learn the lessons of 1 Corinthians 13.

albums.description: Mysteries abound in Odyssey as Eugene and Mathew try to figure out why the Odyssey clock tower is counting down to a mysterious deadline and Emily Jones tries to unmask the phantom of the school play. Meanwhile, the crew at Whit’s End tries fasting – with hilarious results – and Wooton tried his hand at a radio show…with no script! Get ready for 12 exciting stories that reveal just what God can do in our lives.

episodes.description: On a snowy Thanksgiving Day, Whit, Connie, Eugene and a few of their friends end up stuck at Whit's End. To pass the time, they tell a zany story of the Scrunch and his plan for "Thankstaking."

episodes.name: An Agreeable Nanny
episodes.description: The Parker family kids are convinced that they are too grown-up for a babysitter. A parents' night out, a nanny named Maria, and the neighbor's dog Bruno may be their opportunity to prove themselves.

episodes.description: A pinata filled with delicious chocolate goes missing from Whit's End. Only a few people were in the room at the scene of the crime, leading Emily Jones to investigate "whodunit!"

episodes.description: The Parker's grandma comes for a Christmas visit, in the middle of an elaborate celebration cooked up by Eugene and Connie. The Parker family parents wonder if it's possible to have a Christmas without stress.

albums.name: #51: Take It From the Top
albums.description: It’s back to the basics in “Take it from the Top,” the long-anticipated 51st album of Adventures in Odyssey! Enter Whit’s new invention, the Inspiration Station, and find out why Connie wants to spend so much time in it. Solve mysteries with local sleuth Emily Jones, and find out why 10-year-old Matthew Parker doesn’t think being “target of the week” is such a good thing. This album contains family-oriented episodes about everyday life in Odyssey with relevant messages and top-notch fun. Catch up with Whit, Connie, Eugene, and Wooton, and meet the new families as they learn lessons about responsibility, revenge, and God-given inspiration. Whether on a baseball field, at home, or at Whit’s End, there’s never a dull moment in the town of Odyssey!

episodes.description: Connie loves spending time in Whit's newest invention, the Inspiration Station. But when a glitch shuts down the machine, her obsession may go too far.

episodes.description: Simon Jones just wants the hedge trimmed, but his son Barrett can't tear himself away from his portable video game – until it disappears without a trace!

episodes.name: Target of the Week
episodes.description: Matthew is Vance King's “Target of the Week” - which means certain humiliation at the hands of the bully! Matthew decides to take matters into his own hands by getting revenge on Vance during an Odyssey Coyotes baseball game.

episodes.description: Emily Jones is usually right about everything – from solving mysteries to cooking chili. But when she decides to try her hand at matchmaking for her brother Barrett, the singing card she creates may have disastrous consequences.

albums.name: #50 ½: The Truth Chronicles
albums.description: Designed to explain Christian worldview to younger kids and teach them how to make it a part of their lives, this special set features 11 all-new episodes… including 8 stories never before aired on the Adventures in Odyssey broadcast! Are there really right answers to big questions about God, faith and truth? How can you best explain intelligent design? Will Captain Absolutely triumph over the evil schemes of Dr. Relative? And what happens when kids are in charge of their own city—with no adults? There’s absolute adventure ahead with these life-changing stories on seeing the world from a Christian perspective—and that’s no lie.

episodes.name: Kidsboro, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: In the woods behind Whit's End, Mr. Whittaker creates a whole town run entirely by kids. Ryan and his friends decide that they must run the town right, and set out to create their own government, laws, and justice system.

episodes.name: Kidsboro, Part 2 of 3
episodes.description: The new town of Kidsboro is vandalized by an unknown force. Nelson, a young inventor, seems to solve the problem, but his solution leads to the fledgling Kidsboro government being sued for all they are worth.

episodes.name: Kidsboro, Part 3 of 3
episodes.description: Mayor Ryan says that he's installing cameras to keep the residents of Kidsboro safe. But Jill uses her investigative reporting skills to find out what's really going on.

episodes.name: Here Am I
episodes.description: In a dream, Connie tries out Whit's new interactive Kids' Radio and experiences an encounter with the problems of having a secular worldview. Can she convince others that truth is not what they make it to be?

episodes.name: The Truth Be Told
episodes.description: Wooton Bassett creates a new comic book hero named Captain Absolutely, who seeks to fight for truth, justice, and a lot more truth. Meanwhile, Jill Segler is given an opportunity to get the story on Christian worldview for The Odyssey Tribune.

episodes.name: The Science Club

episodes.name: Three in One

albums.description: It’s time for the annual “Best Small Town in America” national competition… and Odyssey’s in the running! This special occasion brings together a hometown reunion of long-lost friends, like the Barclay family, Lucy Cunningham-Schultz and Edwin Blackgaard. But who knows how far everyone will go to take the title? Your family won’t want to miss these brand-new stories with plenty of good old-fashioned fun—Odyssey style!

albums.name: #49: The Sky's the Limit
albums.description: There’s not a kid in Odyssey who wouldn’t love to hang out at Wooton’s house—where comic books and a Cadillac-turned-couch are only half the fun. But when a boy betrays his trust, will Wooton forgive him? Meanwhile, Odyssey’s favorite quirky mailman falls in love with a young lady who’s (gulp!) exactly like him. And the Meltsners face an unexpected decision that could forever change their relationship. What’s next? The Sky’s The Limit in these stories of God’s will, reconciliation and more.

episodes.description: In the Imagination Station, Trent DeWhite journeys to ancient India, the South Pacific, and New York's Constitution Island to see stories of people who were used by God.

Eugene and his father must uncover the truth about a sinister archeologist, so they can finally bring him to justice. And comic mailman Wooton stumbles into a mystery... is someone covertly crying for help? In these 12 stories, small-town Odyssey has big adventure, big laughs and big truths in store.

Meanwhile, Mandy schemes to get her parents back and Connie goes undercover (as a clown!) at Odyssey’s annual carnival. From a birthday party that turns disastrous to amazing Bible stories, Adventures in Odyssey’s Into the Light entertains the whole family with memorable characters and values that matter!

albums.description: He was gone for years. And now that he’s back, you’re about to hear a lot more of Eugene! Why was he gone so long and more importantly, why is Whit hiding the fact that he’s back? Later, Eugene and Katrina prepare to finally have a wedding ceremony in Odyssey. But Connie’s over-the-top wedding plans didn’t call for a burning basement, unruly swans or a missing bride and groom! Eugene Returns celebrates the long-awaited return of a friend who stayed away far too long.

episodes.name: A Most Extraordinary Conclusion

albums.name: #43: Along for the Ride
albums.description: It’s never a smooth ride in Odyssey… A national treasure comes to town and is promptly stolen. The Washington family tries desperately to get to church on time. And a young boy is desperate to chase down a toy lamb? Exciting, heart-warming shows highlight lessons on telling the truth, God’s gifts, and family togetherness. Come along—it could be the ride of your life!

episodes.name: Sounds Like a Mystery
episodes.description: Odyssey is abuzz when a national treasure--a scale model of the Statue of Liberty--comes to town . . . and promptly gets stolen!

episodes.description: The Washingtons try to get to church on time, which leads to chaos in their home.

episodes.description: When Trent is put in the gifted class at school, he wonders if he'll survive his first week. Meanwhile, Aubrey Shepard learns that she has a real talent with horses.

Meanwhile, Trent and Jimmy all find themselves in situations in which they feel like there is no escape. Is there a way out of their predicaments? This exciting Adventures in Odyssey collection answers questions about fear, sacrifice and loyalty.

episodes.description: Connie returns to Odyssey after her long trip, and the crew at Whit's End isn't sure how to act around her since she's grieving over the end of her relationship with Mitch.

episodes.name: Nothing But the Half Truth
episodes.description: Wellington Bassett calls his twin brother, Wooton, for a bizarre favor--he wants Wooton to pretend to be him for a business meeting.

episodes.name: Split Ends

albums.name: #41: In Hot Pursuit

But his cool reception matches the frigid water that nearly cost Connie her life during a stopover in West Virginia. A sudden job opportunity abroad creates yet another crisis for their relationship. Meanwhile, Odyssey’s master of mispronunciation Bart Rathbone decides to sponsor—what else?—a Shakespeare festival. But he ends up with more theatrics behind stage than on it. Throughout these and other conflict-solving stories, kids ages 8 and up will learn that running away from a problem only makes matters worse.

episodes.description: Mandy Straussberg and Liz nearly destroy their friendship while fighting over Seth Young. Meanwhile Connie argues with Robert Mitchell, an event that prompts her to drive to Washington, D.C., to apologize in person.

episodes.name: Black Clouds
episodes.description: As Connie and Joanne's road trip to Washington continues, a raging storm forces them to stop at a roadside diner where they meet a runaway young girl and an unusual woman named Ethel.

episodes.name: The Taming of the Two
episodes.description: Bart Rathbone wants to make his shop more sophisticated, and Malcolm Lear, a rival of Edwin Blackgaard, has a proposal for him.

episodes.name: The Mailman Cometh
episodes.description: The Washington kids, Marvin and Tamika, are determined to show their mom that they should be allowed to do the same things as their older cousin, Xavier.

episodes.name: Silver Lining
episodes.description: On the way to Washington, Connie and Joanne stop in West Virginia and are pulled into a mystery involving a bank robbery, a brave rescue, and an escaped convict.

episodes.name: Teacher's Pest
episodes.description: Max Hampton and Mandy Straussberg, who are complete opposites, must work together on a science project.

episodes.name: Pink is Not My Color
episodes.description: Connie's arrival in Virginia surprises Mitch--and, while staying with the Bourlands, she intercedes in a father-daughter conflict.

episodes.name: Something Blue, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: When Connie gets the news that Mitch might leave for Europe in a few days, the two of them decide to get married immediately.

episodes.name: Something Blue, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: When Connie gets the news that Mitch might leave for Europe in a few days, the two of them decide to get married immediately.

episodes.name: My Girl Hallie
episodes.description: “The Twilife Zone” skit tells the story of a boy named Joey Patrick who has an unusual friendship . . . with his computer.

episodes.name: BONUS! Alternate ending to "My Girl Hallie"
episodes.shortName: #537a: BONUS! Alternate ending to "My Girl Hallie"

albums.name: #40: Out of Control
albums.description: Stand by for chaos! Connie and the gang think they’re doing another a safe, scripted B:TV program. But that’s before the fire, the okra incident and the renegade nose. Meanwhile, Liz’s brother Mark just got engaged. How’s she supposed to fit in now that she’s second fiddle? Missing families, missing identities and missing the point all figure prominently in the 40th installment of Adventures in Odyssey.

episodes.name: For the Fun of It
episodes.description: Talia Bassett decides to get back at her father by spending a week in Odyssey with her uncle--Wooton!

episodes.name: Room Enough for Two
episodes.description: Liz Horton is excited to see her older brother, Mark, come home, until Mark makes a surprise announcement--he's engaged.

episodes.name: B-TV: Behind the Scenes
episodes.description: Alex Jefferson turns a microphone on the B-TV crew to see what happens behind the scenes.

episodes.name: Bassett Hounds
episodes.description: Bernard Walton accompanies Wooton Bassett to Alaska for an unusual family reunion.

episodes.name: It's All About Me
episodes.description: Connie starts a Kids' Radio advice show with Mitch. At school, Trent DeWhite worries that he's getting credit for something he didn't do.

episodes.name: The Case of the Disappearing Hortons
episodes.shortName: #518: The Case of the Disappearing Hortons
episodes.description: When Liz Horton's entire family abruptly goes missing, it's up to the kids of Odyssey (and a few of their friends) to solve the case.

episodes.name: The Defining Moment
episodes.description: After a disappointment in the last inning of a game, Marvin Washington looks to his cousin, Xavier, to show him how to be a hero.

episodes.name: The Mystery at Tin Flat
episodes.description: The Washington family wins an all-expenses-paid vacation to nearby Tin Flat. But when they show up, the town is deserted.

episodes.name: All Things to All People
episodes.description: Seth Young counsels Aubrey Shepard on his radical method of evangelism, which causes Aubrey to question her effectiveness as a Christian.

episodes.name: Here Today, Gone Tomorrow? Part 1 of 3
episodes.shortName: #523: Here Today, Gone Tomorrow? Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: Mitch has to make a decision about the FBI, but his investigating skills are challenged in a case involving Whit and an old nemesis.

episodes.name: Here Today, Gone Tomorrow? Part 2 of 3
episodes.shortName: #524: Here Today, Gone Tomorrow? Part 2 of 3
episodes.description: Mitch has to make a decision about the FBI, but his investigating skills are challenged in a case involving Whit and an old nemesis.

episodes.name: Here Today, Gone Tomorrow? Part 3 of 3
episodes.shortName: #525: Here Today, Gone Tomorrow? Part 3 of 3
episodes.description: Mitch has to make a decision about the FBI, but his investigating skills are challenged in a case involving Whit and an old nemesis.

albums.name: #39: Friends, Family, and Countrymen
albums.description: Things never slow down around Odyssey. Alex is hoping to survive a long weekend with his grandparents, but things get interesting when he sees his grandfather dig up a strange wooden box in the woods. More adventure unfolds as Marvin Washington takes his first trip back in time on the Imagination Station and lands in the middle of the American Revolutionary War.

episodes.name: B-TV: Obedience
episodes.description: B-TV explores the topic of obedience with sketches about the biblical characters Gideon, Naaman, and Moses.

episodes.name: Relatively Annoying
episodes.description: Spending a week at his grandparents' house seems like the end of the world to Alex Jefferson.

episodes.name: The Popsicle Kid
episodes.description: Rodney Rathbone discourages Austin O'Connor from hanging around Colby Cabrera because he's “weird.” Wooton Bassett and the kids try to win a Christmas decorating contest.

episodes.name: Between You and Me
episodes.description: Connie wonders if she's spending too much time with Robert Mitchell. Then he gets an offer from the FBI . . . to move to Virginia.

episodes.name: Aubrey's Bathrobe
episodes.description: A super-Christian named Seth Young makes Aubrey Shepard feel inadequate in her new faith.

episodes.name: The Toy Man
episodes.description: Ed Washington thinks about quitting his high-paying job to work at Whit's End. His family considers the sacrifices they'll have to make.

episodes.name: For Trying Out Loud
episodes.description: Wooton Bassett wants to help Edwin Blackgaard with an upcoming production. Liz Horton tries to find something--anything--she can do better than others.

episodes.name: The Benefit of the Doubt
episodes.description: Robert Mitchell searches for a job in Odyssey, but his work at Novacom scares away potential employers.

episodes.name: The American Revelation, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: In the new Imagination Station, Marvin Washington hears a rarely told story from the American Revolutionary War (1775-1783).

episodes.name: The American Revelation, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: In the new Imagination Station, Marvin Washington hears a rarely told story from the American Revolutionary War (1775-1783).

episodes.name: The Pact, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Whit, Tom Riley, and Mandy Straussberg attempt to discover what's troubling Agnes Riley.

episodes.name: The Pact, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Whit, Tom Riley, and Mandy Straussberg attempt to discover what's troubling Agnes Riley.

albums.name: #38: Battle Lines
albums.description: Strange—no, bizarre things are happening in Odyssey. And it all seems to be connected to one place—Novacom Broadcasting. The mysterious company is involved in all kinds of questionable schemes. And now the townspeople—maybe the whole world—are in danger. Whit’s starting to figure things out, but will it be too little too late? Find out as the Novacom saga races to a startling conclusion!

episodes.name: Under the Influence, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: An old friend pits Aubrey Shepard against her parents and their beliefs.

episodes.name: Under the Influence, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: An old friend pits Aubrey Shepard against her parents and their beliefs.

episodes.name: The Black Veil, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker's stop in Alaska reveals strange problems affecting the members of the church. Meanwhile in Odyssey, Whit notices a strange surge of anger and violence.

episodes.name: The Black Veil, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker's stop in Alaska reveals strange problems affecting the members of the church. Meanwhile in Odyssey, Whit notices a strange surge of anger and violence.

episodes.name: Twisting Pathway
episodes.description: When Mr. Charles makes demands that Kevin Colburn finds uncomfortable, his daughter, Erica, takes things into her own hands.

episodes.name: Sheep's Clothing
episodes.description: Monica Stone tries to steal a disk from Jason, who is in Alaska. Back at Odyssey, Whit and Agent Bourland investigate Novacom.

episodes.name: Box of Miracles
episodes.description: Novacom releases the Novabox, an amazing new technology that seems to heal Tom Riley's wife, Agnes.

episodes.name: The Unraveling
episodes.description: Connie goes to Maine to talk to Robert “Mitch” Mitchell's sister. Working hard in Odyssey, the kids investigate unusual buying trends connected to the Novabox.

episodes.name: Exceptional Circumstances
episodes.description: Connie passes the kids' Novabox information to Mitch, while Jason discovers that Monica Stone has a personal connection to the Novacom scheme.

episodes.name: Expect the Worst
episodes.description: Using Connie's information, Mitch makes a critical connection in proving what Novacom is doing, but the situation changes when the tower on Tom Riley's property blows up.

episodes.name: Exactly As Planned
episodes.description: Whit and Alex Jefferson work to prove Tom's innocence, and Jason learns that Novacom's final scheme is about to be set in motion.

episodes.name: Exit
episodes.description: Whit, Tom, and Jason race to stop Novacom's launch date, but Mr. Charles has a way to stop them.

albums.name: #37: Countermoves
albums.description: Don’t look now, but is that a camera over there?! As the long awaited opening day of the new Whit’s End approaches, all eyes are on Whit and the gang—including some that are uninvited. Jason’s life is no picnic either: a trip back to war-torn South America lands him in jail! Meanwhile, Mandy and Sarah stumble upon an old friend who vanishes, leaving behind a strange secret message with a warning about “Andromeda." The Novacom Saga reaches another level of excitement in “Countermoves.”

episodes.name: Shining Armor, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker returns to a missions project he set up months before and finds that things have gone terribly wrong.

episodes.name: Shining Armor, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker returns to a missions project he set up months before and finds that things have gone terribly wrong.

episodes.name: O. T. Action News: Battle at the Kishon
episodes.shortName: #477: O. T. Action News: Battle at the Kishon
episodes.description: O. T. Action News reports on the story of Deborah and Barak and their battle against the Canaanites.

episodes.name: Strange Boy in a Strange Land
episodes.shortName: #478: Strange Boy in a Strange Land
episodes.description: Mandy Straussberg and Sarah Prachett go camping far from Odyssey and run into an old friend--Jared DeWhite! But Jared's explanation of his disappearance from Odyssey makes them wonder whether or not to believe him.

episodes.name: Happy Smilers
episodes.description: A S.M.I.L.E. convention at the Timothy Center falls apart when the S.M.I.L.E. leader has a heart attack in the middle of the festivities.

episodes.name: Grand Opening, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Whit's End Connellsville opens amidst much fanfare. The celebration is cut short when Whit finds hidden cameras all over the shop.

episodes.name: Grand Opening, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Whit's End Connellsville opens amidst much fanfare. The celebration is cut short when Whit finds hidden cameras all over the shop.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.description: Connie's relationship with Robert Mitchell is tested when she discovers the picture of another girl in his briefcase.

episodes.name: Plan B, Part 1 of 4: Missing in Action
episodes.shortName: #484: Plan B, Part 1 of 4: Missing in Action
episodes.description: As tension increases and more pieces of a sinister plot come together, Whit and Connie find that Eugene has eloped with Katrina Shanks and left town.

episodes.name: Plan B, Part 2 of 4: Collision Course
episodes.shortName: #485: Plan B, Part 2 of 4: Collision Course
episodes.description: Connie continues to investigate Eugene's disappearance and has to decide if she will trust Mitch. Or is he a spy for Novacom?

episodes.name: Plan B, Part 3 of 4: Cross-Fire
episodes.description: Connie mourns the loss of Mitch while Jack Allen and Whit try to retrieve a package with crucial information.

episodes.name: Plan B, Part 4 of 4: Resistance
episodes.description: Wooton Bassett helps Connie deal with Mitch's departure, while Whit collaborates with FBI Agent Bourland.

albums.name: #36: Danger Signals
albums.description: Something sinister is brewing in the quiet town of Odyssey and not even Whit can put his finger on it. The kids are flocking to the new hangout; while back at Whit’s End, the windows are collecting dust—the ones that aren’t being smashed, that is. Things haven’t been the same since media conglomerate Novacom moved in. Even Connie turns to mush whenever Novacom’s new hire, Robert Mitchell, is around. Are the kids losing that small town innocence that always kept them out of harm’s way? The Novacom saga heats up in “Danger Signals.”

episodes.name: The W.E.
episodes.description: To compete with the new Novacom Kids' Center, Whit experiments with a massive overhaul to Whit's End and its attractions.

episodes.name: Green Eyes & Yellow Tulips
episodes.description: Connie falls for a Novacom employee named Robert Mitchell. Bart Rathbone protests that Novacom's programming is immoral.

episodes.name: The Triangle, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Jack Allen and Whit tell Connie the story of how Whit met his wife in college.

episodes.name: The Triangle, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Jack Allen and Whit tell Connie the story of how Whit met his wife in college.

episodes.name: Snow Day
episodes.description: When school is cancelled due to snow, Alex Jefferson accepts a job to deliver cookies to his grandmother. On the way, he must endure many trials and tribulations.

episodes.name: Broken Window
episodes.description: When a window gets broken at Whit's End, Whit puts Rodney, Sarah Prachett, and Alex on trial to see where the responsibility for fixing the window will fall.

episodes.name: Chains, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: As construction begins on Whit's End in Connellsville, Whit learns that many people don't want his shop there after all.

episodes.name: Chains, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: As construction begins on Whit's End in Connellsville, Whit learns that many people don't want his shop there after all.

episodes.name: Break a Leg
episodes.description: In an unfortunate accident, Cal Jordan loses control of his bike. He crashes into Walter Shakespeare, whose leg is broken as a result.

episodes.name: Fifteen Minutes
episodes.description: Alex breaks a miniature-golf record, which rockets him to local fame. Meanwhile, an Odyssey local, who made it big in Hollywood, returns for a visit.

episodes.name: Welcoming Wooton
episodes.description: When Wooton Bassett takes time out of his postal route to help at Whit's End, he gets fired for missing too much work.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.description: As construction on the new Whit's End nears completion, Whit finds his time stretched to the limit.

albums.name: #35: The Big Picture
albums.description: Mandy Straussberg is smack dab in the middle of what might be the worst day of her young life. She’s late for class, gets attacked by an ice machine and even misses her big band audition—all before lunch. Meanwhile, there’s trouble at the Timothy Center and a mysterious character is hacking into the computers at Campbell College. Is Novacom to blame? Step back and see what’s really going on in The Big Picture with these exciting stories of trust, friendship and relying on God. The exciting Novacom Saga begins here.

episodes.name: The Big Deal, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Aubrey Shepard takes an Imagination Station adventure to meet the biblical John the Baptist.

episodes.name: The Big Deal, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Aubrey Shepard takes an Imagination Station adventure to meet the biblical John the Baptist.

episodes.name: Life Trials of the Rich & Famous
episodes.shortName: #451: Life Trials of the Rich & Famous
episodes.description: When Nathaniel Graham's family suddenly becomes very rich, he notices that the kids start to treat him differently.

episodes.name: Missionary Impossible
episodes.description: Alex Jefferson becomes convinced that he should become a missionary like Jason Whittaker.

episodes.name: The Great Wishy Woz, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #453: The Great Wishy Woz, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Kids' Radio features a story about a young girl named Dotty who is transported to a strange land.

episodes.name: The Great Wishy Woz, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #454: The Great Wishy Woz, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Kids' Radio features a story about a young girl named Dotty who is transported to a strange land.

episodes.name: Best Laid Plans
episodes.description: When Jason Whittaker is late to speak at the Timothy Center, Connie tries to keep a restless crowd calm.

episodes.name: Worst Day Ever
episodes.description: Mandy Straussberg has one of those days when one thing after another goes wrong.

episodes.name: Opportunity Knocks
episodes.description: With the Timothy Center in a financial crisis, it seems like an answered prayer when a company called Novacom offers Tom Riley a lot of money to build a tower on his property.

episodes.name: Red Herring
episodes.description: Alex Jefferson and his cousin, Cal Jordan, attempt to find out what Eugene is doing at Campbell College.

episodes.name: Slumber Party
episodes.description: Mandy has a difficult time keeping control of the girls at her slumber party.

episodes.name: Nova Rising
episodes.description: Novacom buys B-TV from Bernard. Meanwhile, Alex and Cal get jobs working for the company.

albums.name: #34: In Your Wildest Dreams
albums.description: You’ll never believe it—Eugene has invented a robot version of Whit! And if you think that’s strange, wait until you hear about all the other odd things going on in Odyssey: Eugene and Connie are getting married? Tom is shutting down the Timothy Center so Bart Rathbone can turn it into a space camp? And—most amazing of all—Harlow Doyle actually solves a case? What in the world is going on?

episodes.name: Passages: Fletcher's Rebellion, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: A woman named Alice tells an incredible story about how she and Tom Riley's son, Timmy, traveled to another world called Marus.

episodes.name: Passages: Fletcher's Rebellion, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: A woman named Alice tells an incredible story about how she and Tom Riley's son, Timmy, traveled to another world called Marus.

episodes.name: Sunset Bowlawater & The Long Way Home
episodes.shortName: #437: Sunset Bowlawater & The Long Way Home
episodes.description: Mandy Straussberg's goldfish narrates the story of his untimely death. Aubrey Shepard is desperate to get away from the Timothy Center and attempts to earn money to go on a youth group outing.

episodes.name: The Lyin' Tale & Two Roads
episodes.description: Aubrey's tale of being scared by a cat seems to become more life-threatening with every telling. Kids' Radio tells the story of two kids who take very different paths in life and yet meet in the same place.

episodes.name: I Slap Floor
episodes.description: Bernard Walton tells Mandy Straussberg and her brother, David, about an extremely strange week in Odyssey.

episodes.name: What Do You Think? & Idol Minds
episodes.shortName: #441: What Do You Think? & Idol Minds
episodes.description: The Room of Consequence allows Liz Horton to hear what other people are thinking. When Whit leaves town for a while, Eugene creates a Whit robot to keep the kids happy.

episodes.name: Changing Rodney
episodes.description: Mandy goes on a mission to turn Rodney Rathbone into a “good” guy, but it's more difficult than she thinks.

episodes.name: The Bad Guy & Bethany's Flood
episodes.description: A “tough” friend of Nick Mulligan's arrives in Odyssey. Things turn unfriendly when Nick finds out that his friend has become a Christian. Bethany Shepard dreams about a wacky version of Noah and the flood.

episodes.name: No Boundaries
episodes.description: Through the Room of Consequence, Alex Jefferson experiences what life would be like if he could do whatever he wanted--without any rules.

episodes.name: A Matter of Manners & The Seven Deadly Dwarves
episodes.shortName: #446: A Matter of Manners & The Seven Deadly Dwarves
episodes.description: David and Alex and are banished from Whit's End for their rude behavior. Bethany dreams that she's Snow DeWhite and meets up with the Seven Deadly Dwarves.

episodes.name: Potlucks & Poetry
episodes.description: Aubrey is so embarrassed by her parents that she does everything she can to keep them from showing up at a poetry reading--including not telling them about it at all.

episodes.name: Mandy's Debut
episodes.description: Two plays that Mandy has written are performed at the Little Theatre--starring the Whit's End crew as themselves!

albums.name: #33: Virtual Realities
albums.description: Dr. Regis Blackgaard is back... and he’s taken over the Imagination Station! Can Whit and Eugene save Aubrey before it’s too late? Meanwhile, the attack on Whit’s famous time-travel machine isn’t the only big news in town—grown-ups are planning the dreaded Year of No Fun! Will this be the end of Odyssey as we know it? Find out in these edge-of-your-seat stories of honesty, responsibility and the biggest mud fight the town has ever seen!

episodes.name: Opening Day
episodes.description: The grand opening of the Timothy Center retreat facilities is full of unexpected surprises, especially when the Shepard family arrives and daughter Aubrey immediately runs away.

episodes.name: Another Man's Shoes
episodes.description: Whit's new invention, the Transmuter, allows Jared DeWhite to walk in the shoes of a school bully for a day.

episodes.name: Blackgaard's Revenge, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: A virus implanted in the Imagination Station with Dr. Blackgaard's personality surfaces and must be destroyed before it takes hold over Aubrey (see album cover art).

episodes.name: Blackgaard's Revenge, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: A virus implanted in the Imagination Station with Dr. Blackgaard's personality surfaces and must be destroyed before it takes hold over Aubrey (see album cover art).

episodes.name: The Buck Starts Here
episodes.description: Whit gives Jared DeWhite, Ashley, and Nathaniel Graham money to spend wisely, and they all use it in different ways.

episodes.name: Something Cliqued Between Us
episodes.description: Liz Horton and Julie are furious when they feel excluded by a clique of girls they call the “Calvin Clones.”

episodes.name: The Eternal Birthday & Bethany's Imaginary Friend
episodes.shortName: #428: The Eternal Birthday & Bethany's Imaginary Friend
episodes.description: Liz experiences her birthday over and over again. Aubrey Shepard is upset at her sister's overactive imagination.

episodes.name: The Y.A.K. Problem
episodes.description: The Odyssey kids believe a new city council member is planning the Year of Anti-Kids.

episodes.name: Blind Girl's Bluff
episodes.description: Aubrey Shepard and Lisa Mulligan cook up a scam using a two-way radio to make people believe that Lisa can see--with her mind.

episodes.name: Where There's Smoke & The Virtual Kid
episodes.shortName: #431: Where There's Smoke & The Virtual Kid
episodes.description: Nathaniel looks up to his new friend Nick Mulligan. Middle-schooler Alex Jefferson creates a website about Whit's End and gets interviewed for the news.

episodes.name: You Win Some, You Lose Some
episodes.shortName: #432: You Win Some, You Lose Some
episodes.description: Two mean-spirited girls make life miserable for Wendy Zannuck and cause a discouraged Connie to quit her job at the Timothy Center.

episodes.name: The Treasure Room & Chain Reaction
episodes.description: Aubrey and Lisa are determined to find out what Whit keeps in a new secret room at Whit's End. David Straussberg puts off mowing Bernard Walton's lawn, but the consequences of his action are enormous.

albums.name: #32: Hidden Treasures
albums.description: Strange things are afoot when a stranger comes to Odyssey... with a secret message for the folks at Whit’s End! Is this “Malachi” really an angel, or is he just crazy? Meanwhile, Jared and Dwayne are in for a surprise when their favorite video game comes to life in the Room of Consequence. And who’s in line for the next Slimy Award? It’s another adventure you won’t want to miss—complete with larger-than-life lessons about thankfulness, faith, and... Gloobers?

episodes.name: Malachi's Message, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: A stranger comes to Odyssey and claims to be an angel with special messages for the folks at Whit's End. After following the man's instructions, Tom finds a necklace from his son who passed away.

episodes.name: Malachi's Message, Part 2 of 3
episodes.description: A stranger comes to Odyssey and claims to be an angel with special messages for the folks at Whit's End. After following the man's instructions, Tom finds a necklace from his son who passed away.

episodes.name: Malachi's Message, Part 3 of 3
episodes.description: A stranger comes to Odyssey and claims to be an angel with special messages for the folks at Whit's End. After following the man's instructions, Tom finds a necklace from his son who passed away.

episodes.name: B-TV: Forgiveness
episodes.description: With help from the Three Little Pigs, Goldilocks, and the Big Bad Wolf, the B-TV gang teaches about forgiveness.

episodes.name: In All Things Give Thanks
episodes.description: Hector, the newest member of the Mulligan clan, wonders what it means to be thankful when he's lived a hard life.

episodes.name: The Devil Made Me Do It
episodes.shortName: #413: The Devil Made Me Do It
episodes.description: Kids' Radio presents “Guilt Trip Jeopardy,” “20/200,” and the “Slimy Awards” to expose the lies of Satan and show believers how to have victory over temptation.

episodes.name: Buried Sin
episodes.description: Jared DeWhite, Dwayne Oswald, and Eugene dig up a mystery when they uncover a long-lost box, which contains the story of a forgotten crime.

episodes.name: Gloobers!
episodes.description: Jared and Dwayne take their favorite computer game Gloobers to the next level when they get a chance to play the game “for real” in the Room of Consequence.

episodes.name: The Tower
episodes.description: Nathaniel Graham takes a trip in the Imagination Station with Eugene to see the Tower of Babel.

episodes.name: Not-So-Trivial Pursuits
episodes.description: Dwayne Oswald faces a tough opponent on a local quiz show. He also faces a tough decision: What should he do when he's given the answers to the quiz-show questions ahead of time?

episodes.name: Telemachus, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Whit tells a story of a young monk on a journey to find out what it means to be Christlike. But when his travels land him in a gladiator arena, his learning turns to action.

episodes.name: Telemachus, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Whit tells a story of a young monk on a journey to find out what it means to be Christlike. But when his travels land him in a gladiator arena, his learning turns to action.

albums.name: #31: Days to Remember
albums.description: St. Patrick’s Day, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, Thanksgiving and Graduation are all Days To Remember in Adventures in Odyssey’s latest audio album! Look back in time—and into the future—to experience holiday havoc and hilarious happenings with your favorite characters... like Eugene at this engagement party, Connie at her graduation, and George Barclay’s life-changing experience. Each exciting episode underlines timeless truths and instills important values such as thankfulness, God’s providence, faith and commitment.

episodes.name: B-TV: Thanks
episodes.description: B-TV explores Thanksgiving with stories about 10 lepers, a king named David, and Harlow the stonecutter.

episodes.name: It's a Pokenberry Christmas, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #385: It's a Pokenberry Christmas, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Whit and Eugene travel to Pokenberry Falls to help George Barclay, who has lost faith that he should be a pastor...which leads to a bizarre series of events.

episodes.name: It's a Pokenberry Christmas, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #386: It's a Pokenberry Christmas, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Whit and Eugene travel to Pokenberry Falls to help George Barclay, who has lost faith that he should be a pastor...which leads to a bizarre series of events.

episodes.name: New Years Eve Live!
episodes.description: The gang from Whit's End hosts a wacky New Year's eve celebration--in front of a live audience!

episodes.name: Wrapped Around Your Finger
episodes.description: Jack and Joanne Allen throw Eugene Meltsner and Katrina Shanks a Valentine's Day engagement party. Eugene wants to give Katrina a ring, but Katrina's father gives her a family heirloom ring the same day.

episodes.name: Saint Patrick:  A Heart Afire, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #394: Saint Patrick:  A Heart Afire, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Whit tells Jared DeWhite the story of Patrick, a slave boy who changed the history of an entire nation through his dedication to Jesus.
