episodes.name: Faster Than a Speeding Ticket
episodes.description: Whit gets a speeding ticket, and Dwayne Oswald gets a D on a history test. Both believe they were the victims of mistakes.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.description: Kevin gets into the Imagination Station and sees examples of God's search for man.

episodes.name: The Graduate
episodes.description: Connie is finally graduating from high school but faces a dilemma when the principal doesn't like the prayer she wants to say at the graduation ceremony.

episodes.name: Natural Born Leader
episodes.description: Jared DeWhite unknowingly selects a mentally challenged student for student council candidacy.

episodes.name: A Lesson From Mike
episodes.description: Julie is surprised by her feelings when a student she barely knows dies a tragic death.

albums.name: #30: Through Thick & Thin
albums.description: Eugene Meltsner, Odyssey’s reigning chess champion, keeps getting beat by the most unlikely contender–and it’s driving him crazy! Meanwhile, Mandy takes an Imagination Station adventure to see what it takes to change history, and an impending tornado puts a whole new spin on how people see the Rathbones. Don’t miss these stories of truth, discernment and more!

episodes.name: Leap of Faith
episodes.description: The Mulligan family and their animals are threatened when heavy rains wash away a levee upriver from their farm.

episodes.name: OT Action News: Jephthah's Vow
episodes.description: The O. T. Action News team tells the biblical story of Jephthah and his hasty vow.

episodes.name: No Bones About It
episodes.description: Dwayne Oswald and Julie find old bones in a cave, and they pique the interest of Bart Rathbone, who is convinced they are the bones of Bigfoot.

episodes.name: The Joke's on You
episodes.description: Julie tells Dwayne that he's funny, which makes him want to be a stand-up comedian!

episodes.name: When in Doubt...Pray!
episodes.description: Eugene takes Mandy Straussberg on an Imagination Station adventure to show her where prayer has made a difference throughout history.

episodes.name: Poor Loser
episodes.description: Eugene nearly has a nervous breakdown when Bernard Walton keeps beating him in chess. Meanwhile, Heather tries to get the volleyball team to work harder.

episodes.name: Tornado!
episodes.description: A tornado hits Odyssey, and the Rathbones lose their home. Mandy wants to do something to help, but the rest of the town is more reluctant.

episodes.name: A Case of Revenge
episodes.description: After Rodney Rathbone wrecks Jared DeWhite's science fair project, Jared accuses him of all sorts of additional misdoings around town.

episodes.name: Bernard and Job
episodes.description: After her dog is involved in a tragic accident, Lisa Mulligan hears the biblical story of Job from Bernard Walton.

episodes.name: The Spy Who Bugged Me
episodes.description: Jared and Dwayne try to find out what's going on in Sarah's Super Secret Sisters Club.

episodes.name: More Like Alicia
episodes.description: Heather wishes she were more like Alicia, the most popular girl in school. Then she gets the chance to be Alicia for one day.

episodes.name: Arizona Sunrise
episodes.description: Jack Allen tells Cody Carper the story of a circuit-riding preacher named Klinger, who has a quest to share the gospel with a dying Native American.

albums.name: #29: Signed, Sealed & Committed
albums.description: They’re starry-eyed. They’re headed for the altar. Only one thing—who are “they”? Eugene and Katrina? Jack and Joanne? Whit and—Whit??! Join the fun as a handful of local kids threaten to go on a “chore strike”, city slicker Nick takes up residence with Odyssey’s newest family, the Mulligans, and a painting with a past teaches a valuable lesson about forgiveness.

episodes.name: For Whom the Wedding Bells Toll, Part 1 of 3
episodes.shortName: #372: For Whom the Wedding Bells Toll, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: Someone is getting married in Odyssey … but who? Is it John Whittaker and Margaret Faye, Eugene Meltsner and Katrina Shanks, or Jack Allen and Joanne Woodston?

episodes.name: The Pushover
episodes.description: Cody Carper is a pushover, and Jared DeWhite is bossy. Whit comes up with a way to help them work together.

episodes.name: Chores No More
episodes.description: The kids in Odyssey think they have too much work to do at home, so they organize the first annual chores strike.

episodes.name: Just Say Yes
episodes.description: The Mulligan family takes in a teenager with an attitude--a relative named Nick.

episodes.name: The Painting
episodes.description: Jack and Joanne Allen open J & J Antiques and are immediately caught up in a mystery involving a millionaire and a long-lost painting.

episodes.name: Best Face Forward
episodes.description: When Connie hears that a famous writer named Mark Herring is going to stop by Whit's End, she decides to make sure everyone is on his or her best behavior.

episodes.name: The One About Trust, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #380: The One About Trust, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: While Connie volunteers to work on Margaret Faye's campaign for mayor of Odyssey, she hears some distressing news about Whit.

episodes.name: The One About Trust, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #381: The One About Trust, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: While Connie volunteers to work on Margaret Faye's campaign for mayor of Odyssey, she hears some distressing news about Whit.

episodes.name: Viva La Difference
episodes.description: The Mulligans take in some of the animals when the Connellsville Zoo closes down.

episodes.name: Amazing Grace
episodes.description: Whit tells Cody Carper the story of John Newton (1725-1807), a man who experienced God's amazing grace.

albums.name: #28: Welcome Home
albums.description: When John Avery Whittaker returns from a lengthy stay in the Middle East, the entire town of Odyssey turns out for a joyous homecoming celebration with fanfare and fireworks. But for Jack, Whit’s arrival means an uneasy reunion—and a tough decision about the future. Then, the phrase “fools rush in” takes on new significance for Eugene when he neglects to seek God’s direction in his relationship with Katrina. Where will God’s plan lead them next?

episodes.name: The Secret Weapon
episodes.description: Connie becomes coach of the Odyssey Coyotes baseball team and has a plan for boosting Sam Johnson's confidence.

episodes.name: The Merchant of Odyssey
episodes.description: Edwin Blackgaard has to borrow money from Bart Rathbone to pay his taxes.

episodes.name: Three Funerals and a Wedding, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #360: Three Funerals and a Wedding, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Connie tells the romantic story of Ruth, who risks all to stay committed to her family.

episodes.name: Three Funerals and a Wedding, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #361: Three Funerals and a Wedding, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Connie tells the romantic story of Ruth, who risks all to stay committed to her family.

episodes.name: The Right Choice, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Stopping in Chicago on the way home from the Middle East, Eugene learns that Katrina Shanks may be marrying someone else!

episodes.name: The Right Choice, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Stopping in Chicago on the way home from the Middle East, Eugene learns that Katrina Shanks may be marrying someone else!

episodes.name: Home, Sweet Home
episodes.description: Whit finally returns to Odyssey--but Connie can't seem to meet up with him.

episodes.name: Clara
episodes.description: Jack Allen tells Eugene about a shocking incident from his past. Whit gets angry and says that he never wants to see Jack again.

episodes.name: Solitary Refinement
episodes.description: Eugene considers joining a monastery to get over the pain of losing Katrina.

episodes.name: The Decision
episodes.description: Whit must decide whether or not to accept an offer to return to the mission field, and so Connie sets out to prove that he is needed in Odyssey.

episodes.name: The Other Woman
episodes.description: The Rathbones sniff out a scandal when they catch Tom Riley visiting a mysterious woman at Hillingdale Haven.

episodes.name: It's a Wrap!
episodes.description: Lucy Cunningham-Schultz and the Kids' Radio team take an in-depth look at Whit's End and the return of John Avery Whittaker.

albums.name: #27: The Search For Whit
albums.description: Just when you think you’ve got things figured out, it seems there’s always another surprise waiting for you! Future career opportunities are front and center for Connie, Jason’s relationship has taken a new turn, and Eugene and Bernard have a courtroom experience that shows them the real meaning of justice.

episodes.name: Letting Go
episodes.description: Zachary Sellers has a hard time adjusting when his mother starts dating again.

episodes.name: B-TV: Compassion
episodes.description: Bernard Walton, Eugene, and the B-TV crew talk about compassion with the help of Marty the shoemaker.

episodes.name: With a Little Help from My Friends
episodes.shortName: #348: With a Little Help from My Friends
episodes.description: Sam Johnson, Connie, and her mother, June Kendall, compare stories about giving in to peer pressure.

episodes.name: Blessings in Disguise
episodes.description: Brenda Perry's pen pal, Thor Douglas, comes to visit, and Brenda is panicked because she has to live up to all the exaggerations she's written.

episodes.name: The Time of Our Lives
episodes.description: Kids' Radio tells a Twilife Zone sketch of Kathy and Jeremy, two kids who have a propensity for wasting time.

episodes.name: What Are You Gonna Do with Your Life?
episodes.shortName: #351: What Are You Gonna Do with Your Life?
episodes.description: As Connie tries to decide on a career, she experiments with several new jobs.

episodes.name: Memories of Jerry
episodes.description: An old postcard triggers Jason Whittaker's memories about the last weekend he spent with his older brother, Jerry.

episodes.name: A Question About Tasha
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker and Tasha Forbes announce that they're getting married . . . tomorrow!

episodes.name: Blind Justice
episodes.description: Eugene and Bernard wind up on the same jury and must decide the fate of a young boy accused of burglary.

episodes.name: The Search for Whit, Part 1 of 3
episodes.shortName: #355: The Search for Whit, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: Jason and Eugene get a cryptic message from Whit in the Middle East, which leads them on a wild investigation that could change Christian history as we know it.

albums.name: #26: Back on the Air
albums.description: On the heels of Dr. Blackgaard’s demise, those who participated in the treachery are feeling the sting of consequence. Meanwhile, new life in Christ means growth for Zack and his mom, and for Eugene, it also brings about the restoration of his relationship with Katrina. And for the Barclays, an intriguing offer finds them seeking God’s will for their future. Lessons about life, love and the importance of following God’s plan are in store for one and all - don’t miss a minute of this exciting series!

episodes.name: Hidden In My Heart
episodes.description: To teach about Bible memorization, Kids' Radio spoofs three popular television programs. Kids' Radio renames them “Star Trip,” “Rescue 119,” and “Laffie the Wonder Dog.”

episodes.name: Love Is in the Air, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #335: Love Is in the Air, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Katrina Shanks and Tasha Forbes arrive back in town, causing all sorts of romantic high jinks with Eugene, Jason, and even Connie.

episodes.name: Love Is in the Air, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #336: Love Is in the Air, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Katrina Shanks and Tasha Forbes arrive back in town, causing all sorts of romantic high jinks with Eugene, Jason, and even Connie.

episodes.name: W-O-R-R-Y
episodes.description: Erica Clark tries to look her best for school pictures; Sam Johnson worries about the upcoming Academic Olympics.

episodes.name: Easy Money
episodes.description: To buy new hockey equipment, Sam Johnson and Butch need money. Sam gets a job and nearly works himself to death while Butch resorts to gambling.

episodes.name: Do, for a Change
episodes.description: Zachary Sellers and Eugene face their first difficulties as new Christians.

episodes.name: Pokenberry Falls, R.F.D., Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: The Barclays are presented with a difficult choice when a small church in New England asks George to be their pastor.

episodes.name: Pokenberry Falls, R.F.D., Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: The Barclays are presented with a difficult choice when a small church in New England asks George to be their pastor.

episodes.name: Welcome Home, Mr. Blackgaard
episodes.description: Edwin Blackgaard returns to Odyssey to take over the Electric Palace and reopen the Harlequin Theatre.

episodes.name: The Pretty Good Samaritan
episodes.description: Charles Edward Thompson's attempt to act like a Good Samaritan is challenged when he meets an annoying boy named Glenn.

episodes.name: Saint Paul: Voyage to Rome
episodes.description: A young Antonius sets off on a sea journey with his father and a prisoner--the apostle Paul.

episodes.name: Saint Paul:  An Appointment with Caesar
episodes.shortName: #347: Saint Paul:  An Appointment with Caesar
episodes.description: The apostle Paul arrives in Rome for his appointment with the emperor.

albums.name: #25: Darkness Before Dawn
albums.description: Dr. Regis Blackgaard is back, and this time he’s after more than just revenge. There’s a secret buried deep beneath Whit’s End that he’ll spare no expense to capture. Lucy gets kidnapped. There’s a vandal on the loose. And the events of Eugene’s entire existence in Odyssey come to one dramatic turning point that will change his life forever. It’s an epic adventure of good vs. evil, heroes and villains and a powerful reminder that in the midst of darkness, light always prevails.

episodes.name: A Little Credit, Please
episodes.description: Connie gets a dose of financial reality after she gets her first credit card, and Bernard Walton gets a new assistant.

episodes.name: Small Fires, Little Pools
episodes.description: When an outbreak of vandalism hits Odyssey, the gang at Whit's End tries to find out who's responsible.

episodes.name: Angels Unaware
episodes.description: A mysterious “clean-up” crew suddenly counters the vandalism around Odyssey. Connie has her suspicions about who is responsible for these new acts of goodness.

episodes.name: Gathering Thunder
episodes.description: To help the gang called the Israelites, Butch spies on the Bones of Rath until his loyalty comes into question.

episodes.name: Moving Targets
episodes.description: Jason and Jack clash about how to handle the growing crisis around Odyssey, leading to Jack's resignation from Whit's End. Meanwhile, Philip Glossman and Professor Bovril show up to investigate the tunnel under Whit's End.

episodes.name: Hard Losses
episodes.description: A new scandal erupts when Tom Riley is accused of unethical campaign practices.

episodes.name: The Return
episodes.description: Dr. Blackgaard returns to Odyssey to challenge Tom Riley's position as mayor.

episodes.name: The Time Has Come
episodes.description: Despondent over his helplessness to influence the ominous events in Odyssey, Eugene creates a search program for the Imagination Station that lets him replay key moments of his life.

episodes.name: Checkmate
episodes.description: The Israelites clean up the Bones of Rath hideout, Lucy Cunningham-Schultz is kidnapped and pressed for information by Jellyfish, and Glossman finally succeeds in shutting down Whit's End.

episodes.name: Another Chance
episodes.description: Rodney Rathbone tells Richard Maxwell about a laptop computer that may contain valuable information about Blackgaard's plans for Odyssey.

episodes.name: The Last Resort
episodes.description: Bernard goes on a covert mission to get information from Jellyfish's laptop computer, and the police arrest Jason Whittaker.

episodes.name: The Final Conflict
episodes.description: The battle between Blackgaard and the gang at Whit's End draws to an explosive close.

albums.name: #24: Risks and Rewards
albums.description: You won't believe what's happening around town these days—Whit's End has a mysterious link to Odyssey's Civil War days, Jack and Erica are finding new ways to serve the community, and Jason has installed a program in the Imagination Station that makes for some interesting complications!

episodes.name: Poetry in Slow Motion
episodes.description: Charles Edward Thompson has a terrible time writing poetry in middle school, but he refuses to ask anyone for help.

episodes.name: Subject Yourself
episodes.description: Lawrence Hodges battles his doctor over getting braces while his mother battles the school board over a new curriculum.

episodes.name: Rewards in Full
episodes.description: Jack Allen and Erica Clark both come up with ideas that help the community; however, neither of them gets credit for it.

episodes.name: Top This!
episodes.description: Courtney Vincent gets into an intense rivalry with her cousin Hannah, and radio shock jock Cryin' Bryan Dern tries to outdo a competing radio station.

episodes.name: The Underground Railroad, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: A stranger tells Jack the story of the Ross family, and their courageous run for freedom to escape slavery.

episodes.name: The Underground Railroad, Part 2 of 3
episodes.description: A stranger tells Jack the story of the Ross family, and their courageous run for freedom to escape slavery.

episodes.description: A stranger tells Jack the story of the Ross family, and their courageous run for freedom to escape slavery.

episodes.name: B-TV: Envy
episodes.description: B-TV tells several Bible stories about envy, including Cain and Abel, David and Bathsheba, and Ahab and Jezebel.

episodes.name: A Touch of Healing, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #318: A Touch of Healing, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker's new Imagination Station program seems to heal people with disabilities. Meanwhile, Connie's elderly grandmother arrives in Odyssey and her health takes a turn for the worse.

episodes.name: A Touch of Healing, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #319: A Touch of Healing, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker's new Imagination Station program seems to heal people with disabilities. Meanwhile, Connie's elderly grandmother arrives in Odyssey and her health takes a turn for the worse.

episodes.name: Where Is Thy Sting?
episodes.description: The death of Connie's grandmother causes her family to ponder what death means for a Christian. Connie's father ponders what death means for a non-Christian.

episodes.name: The Turning Point
episodes.description: Eugene and Katrina's relationship takes a surprising turn after Eugene meets Katrina's father, Armitage Shanks.

albums.name: #23: Twists and Turns
albums.description: Life can be like a roller coaster—you just never know what’s waiting for you around the bend.  Bernard Walton cleans the local television station’s windows, and winds up hosting a new variety show.  Since her father became a pastor, Donna Barclay feels like she needs to be perfect.  But when she sneaks out to go on as a hay ride with her friends, that idea goes up in smoke. And two men rob Holstein’s Bookshop, and use Jenny Roberts as their means of escape.  Can she help the police identify the criminals, even though she’s blind?  Expect the unexpected in this fun-filled, action-packed ride with the crew in Odyssey!

episodes.name: I Want My B-TV!
episodes.description: Bernard Walton and the gang at Whit's End create a new television variety show.

episodes.name: The Truth About Zachary
episodes.description: Lucy Cunningham-Schultz tries to write a news article about Zachary Sellers and find out why he's in a wheelchair.

episodes.name: Preacher's Kid
episodes.description: Donna Barclay is tired of everyone expecting her to be the perfect pastor's child, but her rebellion goes too far.

episodes.name: The Good, the Bad & Butch
episodes.description: Sam Johnson wants to renew his friendship with Butch Evans even though Butch is now a member of the Bones of Rath.

episodes.name: Share & Share Alike
episodes.description: Kids' Radio stages a share-a-thon to benefit a local homeless shelter.

episodes.name: All the Difference in the World
episodes.shortName: #303: All the Difference in the World
episodes.description: Danny Schmidt rebels against his parents because it seems as if other kids get everything they want.

episodes.name: Saint Paul:  The Man from Tarsus
episodes.shortName: #304: Saint Paul:  The Man from Tarsus
episodes.description: In the Imagination Station, Rodney Rathbone and Sam meet the biblical Peter, Barnabas, and a violent man named Saul.

episodes.name: Saint Paul: Set Apart by God
episodes.shortName: #305: Saint Paul: Set Apart by God
episodes.description: In the Imagination Station, Rodney Rathbone and Sam meet the biblical Peter, Barnabas, and a violent man named Saul.

episodes.name: A Victim of Circumstance
episodes.description: When Rodney falls through a skylight at Whit's End and breaks his arm, the Rathbones take Jason Whittaker to court.

episodes.name: The Perfect Witness, Part 1 of 3
episodes.description: A mystery is triggered when two armed men hold up Holstein's Books and take a hostage--a blind girl named Jenny Roberts.

episodes.name: The Perfect Witness, Part 2 of 3
episodes.description: A mystery is triggered when two armed men hold up Holstein's Books and take a hostage--a blind girl named Jenny Roberts.

episodes.name: The Perfect Witness, Part 3 of 3
episodes.description: A mystery is triggered when two armed men hold up Holstein's Books and take a hostage--a blind girl named Jenny Roberts.

albums.name: #22: The Changing Times
albums.description: Odyssey seems full of change these days as Tom Riley runs for mayor, George Barclay and his family discover the difficulties of preparing for the ministry, Jason Whittaker arrives amidst international intrigue and Jack uncovers a strange code book in Whit's workshop.

episodes.name: George Under Pressure
episodes.description: Because George Barclay's demanding schedule is exhausting him, Jimmy and Donna are determined to make sure he takes a day off.

episodes.name: Tom for Mayor, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Philip Glossman returns to look for toxic chemicals on Tom Riley's farm. Meanwhile, Odyssey's mayor resigns, so Tom Riley and Bart Rathbone compete for the office.

episodes.name: Tom for Mayor, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Philip Glossman returns to look for toxic chemicals on Tom Riley's farm. Meanwhile, Odyssey's mayor resigns, so Tom Riley and Bart Rathbone compete for the office.

episodes.name: A Call for Reverend Jimmy
episodes.description: Donna Barclay is annoyed to find herself a source for sermon illustrations, and her brother, Jimmy, wonders if God may be calling him to the ministry.

episodes.name: A Name, Not a Number, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #290: A Name, Not a Number, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker, Whit's son, gets sidetracked from his move to Odyssey when he's called to Europe on a mission. He has to find a missing friend who has been kidnapped by the terrorist organization Red Scorpion.

episodes.name: A Name, Not a Number, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #291: A Name, Not a Number, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: Jason Whittaker, Whit's son, gets sidetracked from his move to Odyssey when he's called to Europe on a mission. He has to find a missing friend who has been kidnapped by the terrorist organization Red Scorpion.

episodes.name: Siege at Jericho
episodes.description: The O. T. Action News team breaks the story of Joshua, Rahab, and a standoff at the walls of Jericho.

episodes.name: A Code of Honor
episodes.description: Jack Allen and Jason Whittaker find a mysterious codebook in Whit's workroom that leads them to a secret gang called the Israelites.

episodes.name: Unto Us a Child Is Born
episodes.shortName: #294: Unto Us a Child Is Born
episodes.description: On Christmas eve, Jimmy produces a live Kids' radio presentation of the birth of Jesus--which includes an unexpected real birth.

episodes.name: Soaplessly Devoted
episodes.description: Jason programs the Room of Consequence so that Erica Clark can actually live in Medical Center of Love, her favorite soap opera.

episodes.name: Red Wagons and Pink Flamingos
episodes.description: Erica and her best friend, Kim Peterson, have an argument that may end their friendship. Meanwhile, Jason and Jack disagree about putting video games in Whit's End.

episodes.name: Blackbeard's Treasure
episodes.description: Two young boys, John Whittaker and Jack Allen, venture into a secret cave and fight off pirates in their quest to find Blackbeard's buried treasure.

albums.name: #21: Wish You Were Here
albums.description: Eugene and Bernard are off to California. What could possibly go wrong? Speeding tickets, earthquakes and discovering an entire town full of Eugenes, to start! What would you do if you were cast in a Hollywood movie? What does a talking chicken have to do with self-control? Buckle up and get set for a cross-country adventure...and stories of trust, compassion and more.

episodes.name: First-Hand Experience
episodes.description: Eugene decides to take a journey away from Odyssey to broaden his horizons and gain new experience … only to find that the road to adventure intersects with Bernard's trip to San Diego.

episodes.name: Second Thoughts
episodes.description: Eugene and Bernard's cross-country journey gets waylaid in the middle of Iowa. There Bernard and Eugene meet Graham, a kid who desperately wants to leave his small-town life.

episodes.name: Third Degree
episodes.description: In Colorado, Eugene meets a group of people who are just like him. Bernard is not so fortunate; he fights a traffic ticket in court.

episodes.name: It Happened at Four Corners
episodes.description: An old prospector, a torn map, and a legendary gold mine interrupt Eugene and Bernard's journey to California and infect them with gold fever.

episodes.name: The Fifth House on the Left, Part 1 of 2
episodes.shortName: #278: The Fifth House on the Left, Part 1 of 2
episodes.description: In Hollywood, Bernard and Eugene meet the Smith-Hammer family. Bernard tells a little girl about Jesus, and Eugene is cast to star in a movie.

episodes.name: The Fifth House on the Left, Part 2 of 2
episodes.shortName: #279: The Fifth House on the Left, Part 2 of 2
episodes.description: In Hollywood, Bernard and Eugene meet the Smith-Hammer family. Bernard tells a little girl about Jesus, and Eugene is cast to star in a movie.

episodes.name: Gone . . .
episodes.description: Bernard and Eugene return from their long road trip to Odyssey, where things always stay the same. Or so they think.

episodes.name: . . . But Not Forgotten
episodes.description: Tom Riley, Connie, and Eugene find that running Whit's End takes more time than they thought. Tom asks an old friend of Whit's, Jack Allen, to help out.

episodes.name: The Fundamentals
episodes.description: Jimmy Barclay attends basketball camp with Phil McFarland, a teen who thinks he knows everything there is to know about the game.

episodes.name: A Book by Its Cover
episodes.description: Connie and Eugene try to see Jack's secret painting, and Katrina Shanks tutors a difficult student.

episodes.name: The Election Deception
episodes.description: When Courtney Vincent's diary disappears from her locker, events conspire against her hopes of being elected president of the student council.

episodes.name: The Twilife Zone
episodes.description: Kids' Radio tells the story of a talking toy chicken that enslaves its owner in a web of strange demands.

albums.name: #20: A Journey of Choices
albums.description: Adopting a dog was supposed to help Donna cope with the changes her family’s had recently. But, it seems that the dog is causing even more chaos! Meanwhile, Sam gets into more trouble than he bargained for when he tries to prove that “nice guys finish last.” And a carelessly uttered word in the middle of an argument between Connie and Eugene wreaks havoc when it becomes the fashionable insult. Don’t miss a second of each exciting, action-packed adventure.

episodes.name: Afraid, Not!
episodes.description: A bully makes young Danny Schmidt afraid of walking to school.

episodes.name: When Bad Isn't So Good

albums.name: #01: The Adventure Begins
albums.description: Meet Whit, Connie and the townspeople of Odyssey through the imaginative writing and heartwarming stories that are the hallmark of Adventures in Odyssey. In this 12-episode collection, you'll relive the very first episode, learn the real story behind Whit's End, and find out why Connie couldn't wait to leave Odyssey the moment she arrived. albums.name: The Officer Harley Collection
albums.description: Officer David Harley appeared in a number of early Adventures in Odyssey episodes. He was voiced by Will Ryan, who later went on to voice Eugene Meltsner. Harley was a bumbling policeman and the producers loved him for his comic potential, but not everyone felt the same way. After parents complained that he gave a bad impression of law enforcers, the team decided that Officer Harley should leave the show. Many of his episodes were later rewritten, retitled, and rerecorded without him. A few others were dropped completely and never aired again. Over the years, we've looked for a place to re-release these episodes as interesting curiosities, so fans could hear the originals. And now, with the Adventures in Odyssey Club, we've finally found the perfect place. Enjoy these episodes that haven't been heard in more than twenty years!

albums.name: Family Portraits
albums.description: In 1987, Focus on the Family aired an experimental radio drama called “Family Portraits.” It featured the first adventures of John Avery Whittaker, Tom Riley, and many others in the small town of Odyssey. After receiving overwhelmingly positive feedback, Focus decided to launch into full-scale production on what became Adeventures in Odyssey. You can now enjoy all twelve episodes in this exclusive collection of the first family audio dramas by Focus on the Family. As you join Whit and his friends in Odyssey for the very first time, timeless truths will be revealed about sibling rivalry, the consequences of lying, peer pressure, parent-child relationships, and the effects of divorce. Also included: A half-hour roundtable discussion with Chuck Bolte, Phil Lollar, and Steve Harris about the creation of the series.

albums.description: Enter a world where ancient history comes to life . . . and faith in God becomes the adventure of a lifetime! Introducing Passages™, the legendary audio series from the creators of Adventures in Odyssey. One minute, Anna and Kyle are exploring a creepy old house outside Odyssey. The next, they’re transported to the mysterious land of Marus—and caught in the middle of a dangerous conflict between a brave army general and a powerful king. Will their newfound powers be strong enough to save the rightful heir to the throne . . . and return them safely home?
